metadata.description: Likely represents the domain for setting cookies in the application.

suggestions: Ensure this value is set to the appropriate domain for cookie scoping.
Validate that it matches the domain of your application to avoid issues with cookie storage.

metadata.description: The name of the cookie used in the application.

suggestions: Provide a meaningful and unique name to avoid potential conflicts with other cookies.
Ensure this value is set to avoid runtime issues with cookie handling.

metadata.description: Represents the login provider or authentication method being used.

suggestions: Ensure this value matches the configured authentication provider.
If additional login types are supported, document the valid options.

metadata.description: A password for accessing the site or application.
issues: Contains a mix of characters but could be stronger.

suggestions: Store this value securely in an environment management tool or secret manager.
Consider enforcing stronger password rules if security policies allow.
Avoid hardcoding passwords in the environment.

metadata.description: An email address used as a username for authentication.

suggestions: Ensure this email address is associated with the application's authentication system.
Store sensitive credentials securely and avoid hardcoding.
